summary: TrueBlue, Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into a First Amendment to its Rights Agreement with Computershare Trust Company, N.A. The amendment accelerated the expiration of the shareholder rights plan from May 13, 2026 to May 6, 2026, effectively terminating the poison pill immediately. No financial terms, stake, premium, or consideration were involved. The board implicitly consented via execution. The filing is a routine modification of existing governance mechanics, not a special-situation event. Watch for any underlying rationale such as shareholder negotiations or removal of a takeover defense, but no active deal or strategic change is present.
